about.tagline: Choose a browser for each link. Free software under the MIT license.
about.privacy: Reroute forwards only {http} and {https} links, and only to executables listed in its configuration file. It uses the network for one thing: asking which version is newest, once a day when it starts (unless turned off in General) and when you press the button above or the update button in the picker. No download, no installation, and nothing sent about you or your browsers.
